decisions.rationale: Status changed in loop 7: the loop-7 education recheck marks it resolved. Loop 6 accepted it and asked Firstmate to authorize the narrowing. Decided: Firstmate decision react-forms-w1-message authorized changing only tests/verify-learner-test.mjs so the no-runnable branch is taken only when no test file in the control report failed, without printing the suite error. Implemented at commit 32213899; the diff 5818253c..32213899 under react/forms-context-and-crud touches only tests/verify-learner-test.mjs and the module lock, adds a per-run flag that is true when any test file in the report has status failed, and adds that flag to the no-runnable condition; every message and every other branch is unchanged. The verifier's sha256 is now 6fe16b97f4eda80d592bfa3486df993a8ba65cb179cc09a0b74f8f9ab5f026dc. Reconciler-reproduced on macOS (darwin), Node 24.2.0 and npm 11.3.0, in a 0700 scratch copy made with git archive of 32213899 (3221389971fd9a1610de7b60b96b85fcc2daf00d), with the private overlay copied over the starter, npm ci in tests/, TMPDIR pointed at a private scratch directory, and the overlay's reference learner test unless stated otherwise. The reference test was accepted with the Task 8 line and exit 0. Learner-side load failure: the reconciler added to the reference test a module-level guard, derived from that test, that throws a distinctive marker string only when the imported default export is the Task 8 variant wrapper, so the file loads in the normal run and fails to load under the check. The normal run showed 'Test Files 8 passed (8)' and 'Tests 8 passed (8)', then npm test printed only the unchanged-copy message ('your test fails against an unchanged copy of your finished form, so it depends on something other than the form's behaviour.') and exited 1. Running the control variant directly gave exit 1 and a JSON report with numTotalTestSuites 1, numFailedTestSuites 1, numTotalTests 0 and one test file with status failed, no assertion results and the marker message. Harness-side load failure: with a module-level throw carrying a second marker string appended to a scratch copy of tests/task8-variant.jsx (restored afterwards; sha256 d85eae98... rechecked), the reference test passed the normal run (8 of 8) and got the same unchanged-copy message, exit 1. Neither marker string appeared in any learner-facing output, so the suite error is not printed, as the decision requires. The unreadable-form message appeared in neither run. Verifier swap with the same learner-side probe: the 5818253c verifier (sha256 7b3e2668...) printed the no-runnable message, exit 1; the c68e4995 verifier (sha256 94e0038a..., the verifier in force for the accepted loop-5 records) printed the unchanged-copy message, exit 1. So 32213899 restores the loop-5 message for a load failure exactly. A deleted learner test file ('Test Files 7 passed (7)') and a todo-only file still got the no-runnable message, exit 1 (reconciler-run). The skip-only case is critic-reported, not rerun. The claim (a load failure under the check told a learner with a finished test that the file may be missing or empty) is resolved. Which message a load failure now gets is decided under edu-fcc-x1 / sme-fcc-x1 and does not reopen this finding. The recorded v1 and v3 lows (edu-fcc-v1, sme-fcc-v1, edu-fcc-v3) are untouched: task8-variant.jsx, t2-labels.test.jsx and the README are byte-identical to loop 6, as the decision requires. Consolidated with sme-fcc-w1.

Claim verified true; consolidated across edu-fcc-x1 and sme-fcc-x1, which describe the same behaviour from the learner and technical sides and carry the same reproduction. Reconciler-reproduced on macOS (darwin), Node 24.2.0 and npm 11.3.0, in a 0700 scratch copy made with git archive of 32213899 (3221389971fd9a1610de7b60b96b85fcc2daf00d), with the private overlay copied over the starter, npm ci in tests/, TMPDIR pointed at a private scratch directory, and the overlay's reference learner test unless stated otherwise. The reference test was accepted with the Task 8 line and exit 0. Learner-side load failure: the reconciler added to the reference test a module-level guard, derived from that test, that throws a distinctive marker string only when the imported default export is the Task 8 variant wrapper, so the file loads in the normal run and fails to load under the check. The normal run showed 'Test Files 8 passed (8)' and 'Tests 8 passed (8)', then npm test printed only the unchanged-copy message ('your test fails against an unchanged copy of your finished form, so it depends on something other than the form's behaviour.') and exited 1. Running the control variant directly gave exit 1 and a JSON report with numTotalTestSuites 1, numFailedTestSuites 1, numTotalTests 0 and one test file with status failed, no assertion results and the marker message. Harness-side load failure: with a module-level throw carrying a second marker string appended to a scratch copy of tests/task8-variant.jsx (restored afterwards; sha256 d85eae98... rechecked), the reference test passed the normal run (8 of 8) and got the same unchanged-copy message, exit 1. Neither marker string appeared in any learner-facing output, so the suite error is not printed, as the decision requires. The unreadable-form message appeared in neither run. Verifier swap with the same learner-side probe: the 5818253c verifier (sha256 7b3e2668...) printed the no-runnable message, exit 1; the c68e4995 verifier (sha256 94e0038a..., the verifier in force for the accepted loop-5 records) printed the unchanged-copy message, exit 1. So 32213899 restores the loop-5 message for a load failure exactly. A deleted learner test file ('Test Files 7 passed (7)') and a todo-only file still got the no-runnable message, exit 1 (reconciler-run). The skip-only case is critic-reported, not rerun. Cause, confirmed from the code: Vitest exits non-zero when a test file fails to load, so the control run is not clean; once the no-runnable branch is narrowed, the not-clean branch is the only one left and prints the unchanged-copy message. The general unreadable-form message is pushed only inside the clean-control branch and only when a behaviour variant writes its unreadable mark to the marks file; a load failure stops before any variant runs, so that message is unreachable for this case without a new branch. Decision: reject-with-evidence, and no byte change is warranted. Reasons. (1) The operative sentence of Firstmate decision react-forms-w1-message is specific and is implemented exactly: change verify-learner-test.mjs only so the no-runnable branch is taken only when no test file in the control report failed, and do not print the suite error. Routing a load failure to the unreadable-form message would need a new branch or message mapping, which that 'only' excludes. (2) The decision's stated purpose is to preserve the already accepted loop-5 message contract. The verifier swap shows the loop-5 (c68e4995) verifier gave the unchanged-copy message for a load failure, and 32213899 gives the same message, so that purpose is met. The rationale's phrase naming the 'general safe unreadable message' does not match the loop-5 behaviour and is read as a misnaming, not as an instruction. (3) The unreadable-form message would be less accurate, not more: it tells the learner to keep the label text inside the <form> element, which has nothing to do with a load failure and would send a learner with correct markup to change it. (4) The output is learner-safe: exit 1, no weak test can be accepted this way, the suite error is not shown and no solution code is revealed. Residual, recorded and not introduced by 32213899: for a harness-side or plugin load failure, the realistic trigger on unrun platforms (Windows and Linux are unverified), the unchanged-copy message wrongly suggests that a correct test depends on something other than the form. For a learner test that really inspects what it imports, the message fits. This is the same residual the loop-6 reconciliation recorded for c68e4995. Severity low, agreed. Firstmate follow-up, outstanding and non-blocking: Firstmate has not yet confirmed in writing that the operative sentence governs over the rationale phrase; this record does not claim that confirmation. If Firstmate wants an accurate message for a load failure, the smallest change is one fixed learner-safe message for a control report with a failed test file and no assertion results (for example, that the check could not load the test even though it ran in the normal suite, and to run npm test again and report it if it persists), still without printing the suite error. That is a new message and a byte change, so it needs a new Firstmate decision and is not recommended for v1. The SME critic's note to add the harness-side module-level throw to the private adversarial controls is already met by the worker's private proof, which records a load-failure probe at 32213899 that was not reported as a missing test and did not show its error. No further correction loop is needed.
